'''Magical Pokémon Journey: Arbok's First Love''' is the seventh monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the 11th and 12th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|2}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
__NOTOC__
==Blurb==
'''''ARBOK'S MAIN SQUEEZE'''''

''The Pokémon meet up with a trainer who's a really nice guy, but his Charmander Pokémon is just a bully! How did such a mismatched pair end up together?'' 

''Then, Arbok's in love, but it's too embarrassed to admit the object of its affection! Can Hazel find out who is the lucky Pokémon?''
